name: mcp-three-way-match
description: Match supplier invoice lines to purchase orders and accepted receipts by SKU with local evidence.

license_key.title: License key
license_key.description: Optional Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Leave blank to use the free tier.

tools.name: three_way_match
tools.description: Compare up to 500 PO/invoice lines by exact SKU, accepted receipts and prior billed quantities. Returns source evidence and exceptions, including offsetting errors. All diagnosis is free; save optionally.

tools.name: report_list
tools.description: List saved report ids, timestamps, document references, status and issue counts. Free on both tiers; paginated, up to 100 reports per call.

tools.name: report_get
tools.description: Read a saved report with source documents, per-SKU evidence and all exceptions. Free on both tiers.

tools.name: report_page
tools.description: Read free pages of large report issues, SKU rows or original source rows. Use report_id from the paginated overview. Unsaved previews expire after 30 minutes and keep only the last two large checks.

tools.name: report_delete
tools.description: Delete one saved report by id, freeing a free-tier storage slot. Does not alter source documents or prior invoice history.

tools.name: report_export_csv
tools.description: Return CSV of saved SKU quantities, prices and issues. Large CSVs paginate; follow next_offset with offset. Formula-like text is escaped. Full source evidence uses report_get/report_page.

tools.name: license_status
tools.description: Report this server's licence state: product, tier free or pro, licence id, expiry, the key source and the upgrade URL. No arguments, no network. Explains a free-tier refusal; license_activate installs a key.

tools.name: license_activate
tools.description: Activate a Pro key (MCPL1.xxx.yyy) from checkout: verified offline against a built-in public key, saved to your config file. A wrong, malformed or expired key is refused, unsaved. license_status reads it back.
